title: Income from Other Sources — Residuary Head and Deemed Income

content.overview: Other-sources computation starts with section 56 income and allows only expenditure incurred wholly and exclusively to earn it, other than capital expenditure and personal expenses. Winnings do not take that deduction. Deemed gifts are included at the enacted value. The residuary head has a narrow deduction. It is not a second business computation.

enhancement.legalPrinciple: The residuary head has a narrow deduction. It is not a second business computation.
enhancement.detailedExplanation: Section 57 allows commission or remuneration for realising dividends and interest, repairs and insurance for let plant, and a residual expenditure to earn the income. Section 58 disallows personal and capital items and, for winnings, any deduction. Family pension has a limited deduction as enacted.
examples: Interest is received and bank charges are incurred to collect it.
The charges are tested under section 57.
A lottery prize is included without a deduction.
